question: What carriers do we work with?
agent_answer:
We work with 3 carriers (TMS):

| ID | Name | Type | Cost/kg | Avg Transit |
|----|------|------|---------|-------------|
| CAR-001 | Kerry Express | Ground | ฿15/kg | 2 days |
| CAR-002 | SCG Cold Chain | Refrigerated | ฿25/kg | 1 day |
| CAR-003 | Flash Express Premium | Refrigerated | ฿35/kg | 1 day |

**Note:** Refrigerated products must use CAR-002 or CAR-003. CAR-001 is ground-only and cannot be used for fresh mangoes.
